final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
